title: Data Structures & Algorithms
tagline: Learn to model, prove, analyze, and implement algorithms with confidence
summary: A comprehensive textbook on problem-solving, asymptotic analysis, arrays and strings, linked structures, stacks and queues, hashing, recursion, sorting and searching, greedy methods, dynamic programming, trees, graphs, range-query structures, number theory, randomized and streaming algorithms, complexity theory, testing, memory, security, and practical engineering trade-offs. Emphasizes contracts, invariants, proof, edge cases, and choosing methods from constraints rather than memorizing recipes.
topics: Binary search trees and balanced trees
Shortest paths: Dijkstra, Bellman–Ford, and beyond
Knapsack, coin change, and subset DP
Divide and conquer and recurrence solving
Intervals, sweep lines, and event ordering
String matching: KMP, Z, and rolling hashes
Tries, suffix structures, and text indexing
Choosing the right algorithm under constraints
